Why Oracle shares are up 13% on Monday?

Oracle ORCL shares are rising on Monday as the broader AI sector gains momentum following Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia CEO. Oracle stock advanced 13% by 11:30 AM ET to trade at $114.37, breaking a seven-session losing streak for the stock. The sustained decline had pushed Oracle to a 52-week low
